meta.title: Lazy tools
meta.description: Keeps rarely used tools out of every request and loads them on demand with toolbox_search / toolbox_load; activation travels through DeepSeek tool_addition / defer_loading instead of resending tool definitions. New conversations start lazy immediately; existing ones are re-restricted when the bundle loads (tools their log already declared stay loaded). Ships tool-census.py to size the resident layer from your own call history. A loaded tool stays resident for that session, while the bundle itself can be disabled or removed at any time.
